Plants of the World Online account: Thymus × brachychaetus nothosubsp. copiosus (F.M.Vázquez & J.Blanco) R.Morales.

The native range of this hybrid is Spain. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is T. mastichina subsp. mastichina × T. zygis subsp. zygis.
